whenToUse: Showing code a reader will copy: install commands, API requests, config files, snippets in docs, blog posts and developer-tool sites.
The same snippet in several languages (CodeTabs), where one language choice should follow the reader across every block on the page.
avoidWhen: Inline code in a sentence — use a <code> element styled by typography.
Editable code — use a code editor, not a display block.
Comparing two versions of a text — use version-history.
a11y: The scrollable code area is a focusable, named group (title or "<language> code"); line numbers are aria-hidden and not selectable.
Copy announces "Copied" (or a failure with a manual fallback) through a polite status; CodeTabs uses the WAI-ARIA Tabs keyboard pattern.
